explanation: Only D1 matters, and its value depends on which state the previous trial reached: 8-10 if it was S2 (10 if that trial went unrewarded, about 8-9 if rewarded), but if it was S1 it is about 2-4 when rewarded and 4-6 when unrewarded. GO is 0-2 and D2 is almost always 0, rising to 1-4 only during runs of unrewarded a2 choices.
